description: This file is a makefile fragment used in the OpenWrt build system for defining image build procedures, including filesystem creation, kernel packaging, and image assembly. It includes rules for building various filesystem images, kernel images, and device-specific images, with support for compression, overlays, and metadata generation.

methods.name: Image/BuildKernel/MkuImage
methods.description: Constructs a kernel image using mkimage with specified architecture, OS, compression, address, entry point, and data.

methods.name: Image/BuildKernel/Initramfs
methods.description: Builds an initramfs image by invoking the Image/Build/Initramfs rule.

methods.name: Image/Build/squashfs
methods.description: Builds a squashfs filesystem image with optional padding and compression.

methods.name: Image/Build/gzip
methods.description: Gzips a specified file if CONFIG_TARGET_IMAGES_GZIP is enabled.

methods.name: Image/Build/targz
methods.description: Creates a tar.gz archive of the target directory.

methods.name: Image/Build/cpiogz
methods.description: Creates a cpio archive compressed with gzip of the target directory.

methods.name: Image/Manifest
methods.description: Generates a manifest of installed packages and optionally a CycloneDX SBOM JSON.

methods.name: Image/mkfs/jffs2
methods.description: Creates a JFFS2 filesystem image with optional padding and end-of-filesystem marker.

methods.name: Image/mkfs/ubifs
methods.description: Creates a UBIFS filesystem image with specified options.

methods.name: Image/mkfs/ext4
methods.description: Creates an ext4 filesystem image with specified block size and reserved space.

methods.name: Image/mkfs/erofs
methods.description: Creates an EROFS filesystem image with specified compression.

methods.name: Image/mkfs/targz
methods.description: Creates a tar.gz archive of a directory.
